ios.desc:
Gondola is a hotel booking platform built for frequent travelers. Book directly with hotels, earn an average of 16% back in hotel points, credit card points, and 3-7% Gondola Cash back, and let Gondola do the work in the background.

Gondola is not an OTA. Unlike Expedia, Booking.com, or credit card portals like Chase Ultimate Rewards and Amex Travel, Gondola books you directly with the hotel, so you keep every point, every status night, and every perk you've earned. Plus 3-7% more.

Built for people who travel enough that the details matter.

--- HOW IT WORKS ---

TRIPLE STACK YOUR REWARDS
Book a hotel and earn three ways at once: hotel loyalty points (Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors, World of Hyatt, IHG One Rewards), your usual credit card points, and 3-7% Gondola Cash back on top. The average traveler earns 16% back. With elite status and the right co-branded card, that goes upwards of 30%.

ROOM RATE MONITOR + AUTOSAVE
Gondola watches your refundable reservations around the clock. When the price drops, AutoSave automatically reprices your stay and puts 100% of the savings back in your pocket. No action required. Travelers save an average of $413 per year.
"Gondola's Room Rate Monitor rebooked my hotel and saved me $970. This is a total game-changer."

YOUR LOYALTY DASHBOARD
Connect your email and Gondola builds a live view of every loyalty account you hold: hotels, airlines, credit cards. See balances, dollar values, and expiration dates in one place. The average traveler discovers over $3,000 in points they didn't know they had.
"I discovered $2,886 in points and immediately booked myself a free trip to Spain."

ONE SEARCH, EVERY HOTEL CHAIN
Compare cash and points rates side-by-side across every major hotel brand. Deal scores, historical pricing, and results sorted by actual point value, so you always know if you're getting a good redemption.

GONDOLA CASH
Earn 3-7% back on every booking. It never expires. Gondola Members earn 3%, Silver earns 5%, Gold earns 7%.

--- BUILT FOR ---
Road warriors who live out of hotels. Consultants and sales reps who change cities every week. Points enthusiasts who refuse to leave rewards on the table.

--- FREE. ALWAYS. ---
No subscription fees. No markups. No hidden costs. Gondola earns a referral commission from hotels, the same one any booking platform collects. You pay nothing extra.

quotes.text:
Hey - Co-Founder of Gondola.ai here. We just released our iOS app that puts a travel hacker in your pocket.  It works 24/7 to organize your points, find price drops on your existing reservations, and books you directly with hotels (no third party).

It’s free and live on the App Store. We’d love feedback from the HN community on how we can make agentic travel even better!
